By our Order dated 20th September 2023, we had directed that the State Government shall complete all necessary formalities and forward the duly approved draft Award to the Nashik Municipal Corporation.
2. We had opined that thereafter we would pass the further orders for directing the Nashik Municipal Corporation to deposit the amount with the State Government as per the draft Award.

3. Today we are informed by Mr. Patel, the learned AGP, that the draft Award has been approved by the State Government and as per the said draft Award they had written a letter to Nashik Municipal Corporation to deposit the amount with the SLAO, Nashik.

4. Mr. Patel has informed the Court that once this amount is deposited, a final Award would be declared and compensation there NOVEMBER 4, 2023 Shubham Talle 3-CP-262-2021.doc under would be paid to the Petitioner within a period of four weeks from the declaration of the said Award.
5.

The learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the Nashik Municipal Corporation has stated that the amount as per the approved draft Award shall be deposited by the Nashik Municipal Corporation with the SLAO, Nashik within a period of 4 weeks from today.
The said statement is accepted as an undertaking to this Court.

6. Since the Nashik Municipal Corporation is supposed to deposit the amount with the SLAO,
Nashik within a period of 4 weeks from today, we place the above matter on board for reporting compliance on 5th December, 2023.
